name: TV renders in Spanish when the shell locale is es

actions.comment: Masthead, dial and up-next rail must all be in Spanish, and no English string may survive next to them.
actions.value: const txt = document.querySelector('.tv')?.innerText || ''; JSON.stringify({ railLabels: [...document.querySelectorAll('.tv .rail-label')].map(n=>n.textContent.trim()), station: document.querySelector('.station-id')?.textContent?.trim(), newChannel: document.querySelector('.chan-new .chan-name')?.textContent?.trim(), newChannelSub: document.querySelector('.chan-new .chan-now')?.textContent?.trim(), leakedEnglish: ['Up next','Dial','New channel','no signal','public domain','Warming up'].filter(s => txt.includes(s)) })

name: The compose modal opens in Spanish and its Compose button arms only with a brief

actions.comment: Empty brief: the button must be disabled and the hint must say so — the failure the user hit.
actions.value: const b=document.querySelector('.modal .foot .btn.solid'); JSON.stringify({ title: document.querySelector('.modal-title')?.textContent?.trim(), placeholder: document.querySelector('.brief')?.getAttribute('placeholder'), hint: document.querySelector('.brief-hint')?.textContent?.trim(), cta: b?.textContent?.trim(), ctaDisabled: b?.disabled, tooltip: b?.parentElement?.getAttribute('title'), examples: [...document.querySelectorAll('.chip')].map(c=>c.textContent.trim()) })

actions.comment: Picking an example must arm the button and flip the hint.

actions.value: const b=document.querySelector('.modal .foot .btn.solid'); JSON.stringify({ brief: document.querySelector('.brief')?.value, hint: document.querySelector('.brief-hint')?.textContent?.trim(), ctaDisabled: b?.disabled, tooltip: b?.parentElement?.getAttribute('title') })
